description:
Powerful 250W Motor for Every Ride
Equipped with a reliable 250W motor, this HITWAY ebike reaches speeds of up to 25 km/h and easily handles 25° slopes, delivering both smooth city commuting and confident mountain performance. The SHIMANO 7-speed gear system ensures flexible shifting for different terrains.
Long-Lasting 36V 12.8Ah Battery – Stylish & Integrated
Enjoy longer rides with a high-capacity 36V 12.8Ah lithium battery, offering an impressive range of 50–80 km per charge. The integrated in-frame design not only looks sleek and modern but also provides added protection and a minimalist aesthetic for your electric bike.
Built for All Terrains with Premium Comfort
Featuring a lockable front suspension fork, 29-inch large tyres, and hydraulic disc brakes, the BK7S Plus offers stability, control, and excellent shock absorption on all road surfaces—ideal for commuting, forest trails, and weekend adventures alike.
Smart Control with NFC & App Connectivity
Unlock your e-bike with a tap of an NFC card or via the mobile app. The smart display and app integration provide real-time riding data such as speed, distance, and battery status, while allowing easy adjustment of PAS modes and lighting controls for a connected riding experience.
Thoughtful & Practical Design for Everyday Use
Designed with your comfort and safety in mind: front and rear lights compliant with German StVZO standards, a durable aluminium alloy frame, a rear rack for daily essentials, and reflective wheel strips for enhanced visibility at night—making every ride safe and stylish.
